spans.s: a. [अप्सु जायते, जन्-ड] Born in or produced from water [[

.]] अब्जेषु चैव रत्नेषु 8. 100 
-ब्जः 
__1 The conch; गाण्डीवं व्याक्षिपत्पार्थः कृष्णोऽप्यब्जमवादयत् [[

.]] (n. also). 
__2 The moon. 
__3 Camphor. 
__4 N. of a tree, Barringtonia Acutangula (निचुल). 
__5 Dhanvantari, [Page0166-2] physician of the gods, said to be produced at the churning of the ocean along with other jewels. cf. अब्जस्तु निचुले शङ्खे पद्मे धन्वन्तरावपि । वैद्येन्दोरपि … [[Nm.]] 
-ब्जम् 
__1 A lotus. 
__2 One thousand millions. 
-Comp. 
-कर्णिका the seed vessel of a lotus. 
-जः, -भवः, -भूः, -योनिः epithets of Brahmā, (being supposed to have sprung from the lotus which arose from the navel of Viṣṇu) 
-कान्तः a class of ten-storeyed buildings. [[

.]] 
-दृश्, -नयन, -नेत्र, -लोचन &c. a. lotus-eyed, having large beautiful eyes. 
-बान्धवः ‘a friend of lotuses.’, the sun. 
-भोगः 
__1 the root of a lotus. 
__2 a cowrie (वराटक) as large as a conch. 
-बाहनः ‘carrying the moon on his forehead’, epithet of Śiva. 
(-ना) ‘having the lotus for her seat’, N. of Lakṣmī. 
-स्थितः N. of Brahmā. 
-हस्तः the sun (represented as holding a lotus in one hand).

__1 A lotus plant. 
__2 A collection of lotuses. 
__3 A place full of lotuses. 
-Comp. 
-पतिः the sun.
